dudkoChecklist.check: MLC is parameter-space local connectivity. The expanding/balanced classification in section 1 is a conjectural framework, not an established exhaustive dichotomy for all quadratic maps. 'Typical' points are only informally specified. Preserve passage to subsequences, all-versus-some branch quantifiers, and all-scale quantifiers in the pure cases.

The center is the critical value c, not the critical point 0. The first return time depends on the point; nonreturning points are outside the return-map domain. A globalized polynomial iterate branch is distinct from the partially defined first-return map. Parameter rescaling retains the reference map's return times.

dudkoChecklist.locator: Conjecture 1.2 and its implication for MLC
dudkoChecklist.check: Keep both uniform shape control and uniform comparison of diameters of the component and its little Mandelbrot copy. A primitive component closure is modeled on a filled cardioid, not automatically a quasidisk. The area-summation argument additionally uses distinct component interiors and the Yoccoz reduction; it is not a proof of the conjectured uniform geometry.

A ql map is a proper degree-two holomorphic branched cover of topological disks U compactly contained in V. Connectedness is equivalent to nonescape of the unique critical point. Uniqueness of straightening to z^2+c uses connected K_f. Hybrid equivalence means a quasiconformal conjugacy near K_f with Beltrami coefficient zero almost everywhere on K_f, not a conformal conjugacy on an arbitrary neighborhood.

Distinguish modulus of the fundamental annulus from mod^+(f). For disconnected K_f the latter is a supremum over separating annuli, not the modulus of an annular domain V minus K_f. Compactness is in the normalized/equivalence-class QL framework introduced in section 3.1, not arbitrary untranslated, unrescaled functions with moving domains.

Bounded type here means uniformly bounded relative renormalization periods of an infinitely ql-renormalizable map. It does not mean bounded absolute periods. The horseshoe is indexed by the chosen bound, has one complex unstable dimension, and attracts the indicated class exponentially. Compactness alone is not hyperbolicity; keep geometric/beau bounds and cited hyperbolicity input distinct.

Do not merge high type (all continued-fraction entries large), bounded rotation type (entries bounded above), periodic rotation type, and bounded ql combinatorics. The stated pacman hyperbolicity theorem retains periodic type inside Theta_bnd. The simple signed-tail formula for theta_n is qualified by Theta_{>1}; the report explicitly calls for adjustments in general.

Pseudo-Siegel bounds are not classical ql annulus bounds and do not assert that every neutral map has a genuine Siegel disk or a locally connected Julia set. The detailed nested-disk description uses irrational theta, almost invariance for specified finite times, and a filled postcritical/mother-hedgehog intersection. Uniform quasidisk control of deeper disks is stated after the appropriate renormalization, not for all depths in the original plane.

The degeneration argument is a sketch. The additive O_p(1) depends on period; 'large but bounded' cannot become a uniform estimate for arbitrary unbounded periods. Puzzle control requires a definite antimolecule separation epsilon. In the satellite alternative, Teichmuller contraction prevents indefinitely excessive growth at suitable levels, not necessarily the second alternative at every level.

The report states bounded-type ql MLC, including the period-doubling Feigenbaum parameter. Extension along the real line and veins is attributed to manuscript [14]; sector-renormalization consequences use manuscript [19]. Record these as report-cited results with the report's publication status, not original proofs read or completed here.

Hausdorff dimension two of the Mandelbrot boundary does not imply positive area; area zero remains conjectural here. The still-open unbounded satellite cases and positive/zero-entropy interpolation prevent declaring full MLC proved. Virtual Julia sets control only finitely many first returns and are not invariant full postcritical sets.

Lavaurs limits involve selected parameter sequences, iterates and a transition/phase datum; ordinary convergence c_n -> c does not determine a unique enriched limit. Puzzle first-return constructions require a nice boundary and a returning critical point; do not silently assign a critical branch when the critical point does not return.

lomonacoMukherjeeChecklist.check: For rational R=A/B, interpret the equation projectively after clearing denominators and removing the diagonal component of A(w)B(z)-A(z)B(w). Its residual algebraic closure has bidegree (d-1:d-1). It is not merely the pointwise relation R(w)=R(z), w!=z: critical diagonal limit points and poles/infinity need correct treatment.

Separate the locally connected topological polynomial mating, parabolic rational hybrid mating, and the parameter homeomorphism. Böttcher boundary extension is generally a semiconjugacy, not a one-to-one boundary conjugacy. Keep A modulo sign and B=1-A^2. Theorem 2.3 is for a in M_Gamma, not every complex a. Theorem 2.4 gives conformality on the interior and extension to a pinched neighborhood, not a global conformal parameter equivalence.

lomonacoMukherjeeChecklist.locator: sections 2.2 and 3, parabolic-like and degenerate p-l maps
lomonacoMukherjeeChecklist.check: Do not identify parabolic-like maps with polynomial-like maps: U' need not lie in U, the dividing arc and parabolic fixed point are part of the data. Degree-two straightening uniqueness is conditional on connected K. The report's degenerate p-l description is explicitly rough; a full atomic definition needs the precise regularity, boundary, pinching and properness conditions from the cited original, which has not yet been read.

Retain proper subdomain, continuous extension to the closure, antimeromorphic interior and pointwise-fixed boundary. The rational uniformization characterization assumes simple connectivity, infinity not on the boundary, and int(closure(U))=U. If the uniformizing rational map has degree d, the reflection restrictions have degrees d-1 into U and d into the interior of its complement.

T^0 is the droplet with cusp/double-point singularities removed. Nonescaping points remain in U union the singular set. Escaping means reaching T^0, not merely tending to infinity; in the deltoid model infinity belongs to the nonescaping attracting basin. Schwarz reflection is generally partially defined, not a global antirational self-map of the sphere.

Conformal conjugacy on interiors with boundary continuation is not a quasiconformal neighborhood conjugacy. Deltoid mating is conformal, its limit curve is not a quasicircle, and its welding is not quasisymmetric; ordinary polynomial-like straightening does not apply. Explain the convention for a conformal conjugacy on a filled compact set.

lomonacoMukherjeeChecklist.locator: section 4.3.1, C&C family; section 4.3.2, Chebyshev family
lomonacoMukherjeeChecklist.check: The C&C result first quoted is for geometrically finite antipolynomials in the basilica limb of the Tricorn. The parameter comparison is between combinatorial models, not an asserted homeomorphism of the entire actual connectedness loci. In the Chebyshev family distinguish the free critical point from the passive critical point that escapes in one step; the external map is anti-Farey, not the unfactored Nielsen map.

Necklace groups require a 2-connected outerplanar contact graph, whereas the general kissing-group correspondence uses 2-connected simple plane graphs. Plane embedding data and the specified equivalences matter: graphs modulo plane isomorphism, groups modulo quasiconformal conjugacy, maps modulo Mobius conjugacy. Rank d+1 corresponds to degree d. The David conjugacy does not automatically become quasiconformal.

Retain possibly nodal sphere, invariant partition, properly discontinuous group-like dynamics and quotient orbifold, two copies of K(P) intersecting in at most finitely many points, and forward/backward branches of the correct degree and orientation. An orbit-equivalent Nielsen or Bowen-Series map is not the same object as the full group action.

Preserve connected Julia set AND the alternative: geometrically finite OR (all periodic cycles repelling AND finitely renormalizable). Finite renormalizability alone is insufficient. The antiholomorphic result is for the specified ideal-polygon and anti-Hecke groups. The holomorphic result is for finite-type hyperbolic genus-zero orbifolds with at most one order-two and at most one order-nu>=3 cone point, and degree d_Sigma=1-2*alpha*chi_orb(Sigma), alpha=nu when present and 1 otherwise. Do not replace this with arbitrary Fuchsian groups or arbitrary degrees.

Both postcritically finite and hyperbolic are assumed for the antipolynomial. The necklace group has rank d+1. Conformal mateability is equivalent to topological mateability under these assumptions, so the absence of a Moore obstruction cannot be discarded. The conclusion is realization by a Schwarz reflection, not an unconditional mating of every pair.

Require a parabolic fixed point of multiplier one and a fully invariant, simply connected immediate attracting basin. For an antiholomorphic fixed point clarify multiplier via the holomorphic second iterate. The group is anti-Hecke G_d or Hecke H_{d+1}, respectively. The uniformizing polynomial has degree d+1; the correspondence has bidegree d:d. The parabolic rational theorem does not prove the original conjecture for every connected polynomial.

Keep composition order: Cov_0^R composed with eta^- is the displayed antiholomorphic construction; J composed with Cov_0^Q is the modular/Hecke convention. They can be related by conjugating with an involution, but are not literally equal. Distinguish a rational map on a smooth sphere from a branched cover on a nodal sphere.

Keep hyperbolic Blaschke inputs and the restricted genus-zero orbifold class. The conclusion is existence on a suitable compact hyperelliptic surface, not every prescribed genus or arbitrary Fuchsian inputs. 'Combines' means specific invariant group-like regions and specific forward branches, not a single global conjugacy to all the inputs. Only the original's introductory Theorem A was read.

Modular/Parabolic Multibrot have a stated natural bijection; its being a homeomorphism is conjectural here. Product embeddings use C_{d,fr} or the main hyperbolic component, not the entire connectedness locus. Bers-slice compactification homeomorphism is qualified by complex Teichmuller dimension one. Precompactness is not a full classification of all Bers-boundary dynamics.

The graph criterion for boundedness on the antirational side concerns pared deformation spaces with bounded repelling multipliers, not entire hyperbolic components. Removability statements retain connectedness and geometric finiteness or the specified necklace/Bers-boundary class. Homeomorphic fractals with isomorphic quasisymmetry groups need not be quasiconformally equivalent.
